translation: 85-86: The life span of a native or a querist , is reckoned from the quarter (Pada) of the Nakshatra effective at birth time or at the time the query is raised. Whatever number of years ascribed to the 9 signs (representing the said quarter) happened to be the life span of the individual. Many Astrological scholars opined that if the birth is in the first part (beginning) of the quarter, the native is bestowed full life span (पूर्णायु) and if in the middle of the quarter, the person will have half the span of his life. If the birth is at the fag end of the quarter, the native may undergo deathlike sufferings.

114-119 : If the movements is from Virgo Dasa to Cancer, travelling towards easternly direction be favourable and journey towards North at that time will also be beneficial.
Travelling to eastern direction is prohibited during the movement of Leo Dasa to Gemini Dasa. When Cancer Dasa moves to Leo Dasa and if the native undertakes the journey, the mission will not be accomplished and he will have to proceed to west instead of south. The combinations (Yogas) of the benefic planets render favourable results while malefics combinations denote unfavourable results.

translation: 120-122: According to the Kalachakra Dasa system, if the birth is in the Navamsa of Aries, the native will be brave but a thief. If the birth be in the Taurus Navamsa, the native will be wealthy and the Gemini Navamsa makes the native learned. The Cancer Navamsa's birth, will get him kingship. The native will be honoured by the king (authorities) if birth is in Leo Navamsa. If the birth be in the Navamsa of Virgo, the native becomes scholar. The birth in Libra Navamsa gets him ministership (a very high Government position) while in Scorpio Navamsa makes him pauper. If birth is in Sagittarius Navamsa, the native will be highly educated but birth in the Navamsa of Capricorn makes him commit sins. The native becomes businessman if born in the Aquarius Navamsa and if the birth be in the Pisces Navamsa, he becomes wealth.

translation: 123-128: If Deha and Jeeva signs are occupied by any of the planets, Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu death may be anticipated. If more than one of these planets are the occupant, the damages get beyond redemption (in otherwords the results will be disastrous). If Deha sign is afflicted by the malefic planets, disease will set in, and if Jeeva sign is tenanted by the malefics, sufferings through mental illness are predictable. translation:
185-187 : First, the 9th sign from the Ascendant, and then signs aspected by the 9th sign followed by the 10th sign and the signs aspected by 10th sign and thereafter 11th sign, the signs aspected by the 11th sign are the Dasas of the signs under Driga Dasa system. The sequence of the Dasa are decided on the basis of aspects and that is why it is called Driga-Dasa system.
The signs 9th, 10th, 11th from the Ascendant are respectively movable, fixed and dual. In the event of movable signs the count toward aspected signs be forward and in that of fixed signs, the counting upto the aspected sign be in the reverse order. In case of dual sign, if it is odd sign, forward counting and even sign backward counting, upto the aspected signs be resorted to.
Notes : In Driga Dasa system, the first Dasa in the sequence will be that of the sign of the 9th house from the Ascendant and followed by the Dasas of the aspected signs from the 9th house. The next set of Dasa will be of 10th sign succeeded by the aspected sign from the 10th house and the last set of Dasa contains the Dasas of the sign of the 11th house and its aspected signs.
The subject of the aspects etc., has already been dealt with in Chapter- 9 in volume 1. However, for quick recapitulation, the same is being briefly exaplained over here. i) The movable signs, aspects all the fixed signs skipping sign next to it.
ii) The fixed signs, ignoring adjacent movable sign (in 12th house), aspects all the movable signs.
iii) The dual sign, leaving aside itself, aspects all the dual signs. The 9th, 10th or 11th house if contains movable sign, the forwarding counting be undertaken and in case of fixed sign backward counting be adopted. In respect of dual signs, the even sign prompts onwards and the odd one reverse counting. In the process, as many signs so emerged, will be included into the Drig-Dasa cycle of the native. In the standard horoscope, the 9th house from the Ascendant has Virgo sign which is a dual sign and also an even sign. Therefore, reverse counting be resorted to. From Virgo the other dual signs Gemini, Pisces and Sagittarius are under the aspect. The 10th house has Libra sign which is a movable sign hence forward counting. The aspected signs are Leo, Taurus, Aquarius. Likewise, the 11th house is having fixed sign in it, hence reverse counting. The signs under aspects are Capricorn, Aries, Cancer in that order. Here also, the Dasa period (years) will be in accordance to Sthir Dasa system.

translation:
It means that if Mars is malefic, it sets in disease, trouble, some time theft, fire, imprisonment, injury, weak eyesight, displeasure from king (Government) etc.

Other ancient works gave detailed account of the effects of the Dasa of malefic Mars. According to Jataka Parijata, during the Dasa of afflicted Mars, the native suffers from bile, blood infection, painful fever, company of unchaste women, conflict with wife, disrespect to preceptor, friends and lack of affection for son and would consume bad food.

Ancient Scholars viz., Kalidasa and Manteshwara expressed the same opinion. However, Savant Kalyan Verma's contention on this subject is at variance and according to him when the Dasa of the afflicted Mars is in progress, the native suffers from epilepsy, cuts and wounds and he tends to become arrogant, unethical and irreligious.

The native becomes an administrator of state or village (town).
The native's religious instinct gets stirred up and they construct temples and tanks.
The native takes pleasure in giving donations of food and similar charitable acts.
The native eats sumptuous food with sweets.
The native gets enthusiastic towards their work.
The native has the comfort of status, wealth, assets, wife, children, etc.

1-3: Sage Parasara said - O Brahim ! Now I am going to perorate before you the auspicious and inauspicious results of the Dasas namely, Chara, Sthira etc., which were narrated by me earlier.

translation: 4-10: If there are malefic planets posited in the 8th, the 9th and the 5th houses from the sign having the running Dasa, O-Brahim! their Dasas will offer troublesome results. The sign which is having malefic planet in the 3rd and the 6th houses from it, the Dasa of that sign will bring victory etc., and if these houses contain benefic planets in it, the defeat will be the result. If the 11th house from the Dasa-sign is occupied by a malefic or benefic planet, that Dasa will invariably be beneficial. Dasa-sign conjunct with or being in the sign of a benefic planet, such Dasa will always deliver auspicious results. An auspicious sign if is conjunct with a malefic planet, that Dasa of the sign will first give favourable and then unfavourable results. If inauspicious sign is having a conjunction of a benefic planet, it will also first give beneficial and then deleterious results. Should there be malefic planet in the inauspicious sign, the Dasa of this sign will usher all round harmful results. If there are both benefic and malefic planets in an auspicious sign, the Dasa of such a sign will undoubtedly, provide first the detrimental and then advantageous results. The Dasas of the auspicious sign will command fully favourable and of the inauspicious sign will produce completely unfavourable results.

rule.out_of_scope_reason: relates to running Dasa sign as reference frame and benefic/malefic classes which are not expressible

effects.statement: the Dasa of the sign will offer troublesome results

translation:
11-17: Positioning of benefic planets in the 2nd and the 5th houses, certainly bring affection of the king and victory. If there are malefic planets in these houses, the results of the Dasa will definitely be considered as inauspicious. If there are benefic planets in the 5th and the 8th houses, happiness and sound health is indicated. The position of benefic planets in the 9th house, rise in the religious thinkings and affection from preceptors will be the result of the Dasa and in the opposite situation, the converse results and in case of both benefic and malefic planets, mixed results will be indicative. If inauspicious sign tenants malefic planet, it will cause mental and bodily sufferings. The position of malefic in the 7th house will make the wife of the native to face health hazards. The malefic planet in the 4th house results in the loss of or displacement from the house; in the 5th suffering to son, in the 10th house degradation in the status or fame, in the 9th house, it will cause distress to the father. If the 11th house from the Dasa-sign, has malefic planets, all sorts of obstacles and if the said house is occupied by the benefic planets, extra-ordinary happiness will be felt during the Dasa. Should the Angular houses (Kendras) are tenanted by the benefic planets, gain in wealth and win-over of the enemies be expected.
The disposition of planets at birth time and in transit over the sign during the Dasa be interpolated before determining the Dasas results.

78-83½: The Dasa of the planet in its deep exaltation and extremely powerful is considered wholesome (full) Dasa. This Dasa produces kingly type of comforts and tremendous happiness. In this Dasa abandunt wealth, exuberant comforts get enhanced. The Dasa of the exalted and powerful planet is "Dasa in totality" which brings about, copious luxuries but also with some kind of ailments. The Dasa of a deep debilitated and weak planet is considered as a defunct Dasa. This Dasa results in disease, loss of wealth, death etc. The Dasa of a planet, located between deep exaltation points and deep debilitated point in friendly sign, in exaltation sign is known as "Avarohini" (middle level or decending Dasa) which gives less wealth. The Dasa of planet, positioned inbetween deep debilitation and deep exaltation points is called 'Arohini' or ascending Dasa. The Dasa of a planet which is in debilitation, in the hold of inimical sign is called Adhama (evil) which enhances fear, conflicts, disease etc.
These Dasas produce results true to their names when in operation.

translation: 90-96: Commencing from the sign in which the lord of the Dasa is posited, the twelve signs in seriatim will represent 12 Antardasas. The Antardasa of the sign tenanting its lord or friendly planet, produces gain of territory (kingdom etc.), property etc. types of favourable results. The Antardasa of the signs of trik houses (the 6th, the 8th or the 12th) or the sign possesing malefic, debilitated, inimical planets brings about loss of wealth, calamities, diseases, danger of death etc., kind of unfavourable results. The Antardasa of the signs having more benefic points (in Ashtakvarga), give favourable and the signs having malefic points, give unfavourable results : For ascertaining the results related to the native (Son, wife, father etc.) treat the house signified by them as Ascendant and perceive the characteristics of the other houses as normally done for the radical Ascendant. Like, for son assume the 5th house, for wife assume the 7th house as Ascendant and so on. translation:
It goes on to say that commencing from the time of birth, one year will belong to the Moon, followed by 2 years to Venus, 18 years to Jupiter, 20 years to the Sun and thereafter 50 years are the natural period for Saturn. The natural Dasa years has great bearings on the Vimshottari Dasa system. At the time of operation of a particular Dasa in the life span, if the lord of natural Dasa is also become lord of the Mahadasa, the related events of the said Dasa are bound to occur. v)	The lord of Angles or Trines if happened to be a Yoga Karaka, it will render good results.
However before deciding the aspect of Yogakaraka, we have to consider the Ascendants of the Moon and the Sun. Apart from being birth Ascendants, if a planet which gets approved as Yogakaraka planet in these two Ascendants, it will be highly capable of producing auspicious results than the Yogakaraka planets without it. Infact, the selection of the Yogakaraka planet in this manner, will certainly bring about wealth, status, success etc. vi)	Compound relationship of the planet (Panchdha Maitri Chakra) plays a great role in ascertaining the results of the Antardasas. Suppose the Antardasa of Saturn in the Mahadasa of the Sun is in operation and as per the compound relationship of the nativity, Saturn is a bitter enemy of the Sun, then Saturn inspite of being a Yogakaraka planet will not give that much good results in its Antardasa. Further, an inimical sub-period lord degrades the results of the Mahadasa in its Antardasa period. For example, the Antardasa of Rahu in the main period of the Moon, brings mental tension, develops irritable behaviour, loses vitality etc., regardless of whether Rahu draws good or bad influences on the Moon.
vii) Whenever two planets whose main and sub-periods have come to operate and they are enemy to the lord of a particular house, the said house will certainly receive adverse affects relating to the significance of the house. The auspicious positions of the lords of the Mahadasa and Antardasa will, on the other hand, boost up the good results.
viii) Lord of Antardasa does influence the lord of the Mahadasa even though they may not have any connections. However, if they do have one, the effect will be more pronounced.
ix) In the event of Antardasa and Mahadasa being of one planet, this planet will have the prerogative of shaping the events in its Antardasa. if such planet is strong and belongs to an auspicious house, the good results are heightened and in a contrary situation, it will have dampening effects.
x) Antardasa of a retrograde planet whether benefic or malefic, does cause delay, uncertainty, change etc.
xi) The planet being exalted, in Mooltrikona or in own sign, having high Shadabala rating, high benefic points in Astakvarga and if not combust or in an infancy stage or of old age but located in the middle cusp and having benefic 'Avasthas', it will produce excellent results.
xii) Ista, Kashta Balas of a planet should invariably be determined because, Maharishi Parasara has said very clearly that the auspicious and inauspicious results of a Mahadasa should be ascertained only on these basis.
xiii) More the number of benefic connections exist between the lords of the houses in a horoscope, the greater degree of favourable results will be promised.
xiv) If the natural benefic planets go into the malefic Vargas xv) (Divisions), it loses the beneficence. Conversely, if malefic planets occupy more of the benefic Vargas (Divisional Charts), it will gain benefic potency. The Vargas of own sign, exaltation sign, signs of the benefic planets are considered good positions in the divisional charts. While the positions of debilitated sign, enemy sign, signs of the malefic planets etc. are in bad locations in the chart and will spoil the good effects. While analysing the effects of the Antardasa, the transiting positions of the planets should carefully be examined before arriving at any conclusion. Example : 18
On the basis of these principles, a horoscope has been analysed as under:
Data : Date of birth, 1/2, Feb, 1963; Time of birth, 4-00 p.m. (IST); Latitude 28°-37'N; Longitude 77°-54'E. In the Anatardasa of the Sun in Sun's Mahadasa, i.e. between 30-5-1963 and 16-9-1963, the child had undergone operation for cutting the string attached between the tongue and the lower Jaw because this extended flesh was creating problems for the child. The Sun is in the 2nd house alongwith Ketu and Saturn (bitter enemy) receiving the rnalefic aspects of Mars and Rahu. The Sun is in Kumara and Khala Avasthas and also having aspects of Satum in Trimsamsa chart. The Karaka for mouth is Venus which is in the Nakshatra of Ketu and Ketu is occupying the place of mouth in Trimsamsa. Incidentally, the Sun is connected with Satum in most of the divisional charts. The 'Kashta Bala' of the Sun is 35.10 and therefore, this is an indicator of imposing trouble as per its situation and has as such, caused the disease signified by the 2nd house i.e. mouth. This was followed by a disease in the eye. Here again affliction of the 2nd house caused this disease because 2nd house also represents eye. The Dwadamsa represent parents. In the divisional chart, the Sun is in the 9th house and is in its own sign. The Sun has more than the required strength in Shadbala. The Sun is in "Prakasha" Avastha, which promises abundant wealth. In this duration viz., in the Antardasa of the Sun and in Sun's main period, the native's father had acquired sizable amount of wealth. However, the moot point is that the Sun inspite of being the lord of the 9th house had caused trouble to the native in its Antardasa and the main reason for this divergent result is that the Sun acquired different type of odd situations created by the varied combinations. The Sun is the Karaka for bones. The Pisces sign and 12th house represent feet. When the Sun being the lord of the 6th House posited in the 12th house and Jupiter lord of 12th is not in a good house and both the Sun and Jupiter are also having other malefic influences, thereby creating chances of fracture etc., to the feet in the period of the Sun. This aspect will get amply clarified through an example appended below : Data : Date of birth 19.3.1982; Time of birth 6-38 a.m. (IST). Place of birth, Delhi. Shadbala : 7-78 Rupas
The Sun being the lord of the 6th house is situated in the Ascendant which represents body with affliction. Here the sign signifies the feet. The malefic Saturn is quite strong in Shadbala and aspects Sun along with Mars which undoubtedly is not good for the body. The Sun not only having aspects from its stauch enemy Saturn but also is in Saturn's Nakshatra. The Antardasa and also the Mahadasa of the Sun was running from 26.10.1993 to 12.2.1994. In this period, one foot of the native got crushed due to fall of heavy weight and bones of the foot suffered multi-fracture. The Shayana Avastha of the Sun is also responsible for this suffering because Sage Parasara has very clearly stated in the aphorism that if the Sun is passing through the Shayana Avastha, the feet of the native will get affected.

rule.out_of_scope_reason: dignity or specific lordship condition on Sun combined with house ownership where sun is the lord of 2nd or 7th but sun itself is a planet; wait, the verse says 'If the Sun is the lord of the 2nd or the 7th house' -- Sun can never be the lord of the 2nd or 7th house for any ascendant (for Leo ascendant, Sun is 1st lord; for Cancer, 2nd lord; for Capricorn, 8th lord, etc. Wait, Leo ascendant has 2nd lord Mercury, 7th lord Saturn. Cancer ascendant has 2nd lord Sun! Wait! Cancer ascendant: 2nd house Leo, lord is Sun! Aquarius ascendant: 7th house Leo, lord is Sun! There is no atom for `lord_of_house` being a specific planet (e.g. planet=sun, lord_of=2). The available atom is `lord_of_house_in_house` which specifies whose lord is in which house, or `lord_of_house_in_sign`. There is no token to assert 'Planet X is the lord of House Y'.

translation: 56-58: The Sage Parasara Said - O Maitreya ! In this manner, perceive the effects of Kalachakra Dasas and Antardasas in the Savya Chakra. In the same way, the effects of the Dasas and Antardasas of the signs of Apsavya Chakra be understood. The auspicious and inauspicious results are endured by the living beings in accordance to good or bad Karmas (actions) of the previous births. If the malefic planets who deliver inauspicious results are friendly with the lord of the Dasa-sign, the Antardasas of such planets would render benefic results and on the other hand, if the benefic planets are the enemy of the lord of the Dasa-sign, the Antardasa of such planets would produce inauspicious results. Here are some examples related to Kalachakra Dasa to show its application and efficacy of the system. The learned of the Hora Shastra (होरा शास्त्र) have explicitly narrated the results of the planets being combust, in inimical sign, in debilitation or in friendly or in the sign of exaltation. translation: 1-5½: Maharishi Parasara said - O Vipra ! First of all the signs after the Trikona Shodhana (Triagular reductions) should be written down separately and thereafter Ekadhipatya Shodhana (reduction) should be carried out. This reduction is applied if both the signs (of a planet) are left with some number (after the Trikona reduction). Further, if two signs have one lord and after the Trikona reduction, one sign is left with some number while the other does not contain any number, the Ekadhipatya reduction is not applicable. If both the signs of a planet are devoid of any planet and the numbers in both these signs are dissimilar, make the larger number equal to the smaller number. If there are planets in both the signs owned be a planet, no Ekadhipatya reduction is called for. If one of the two signs owned by the same planet is occupied and the other is not, and the number in the sign with the planets is lesser than the sign without a planet after the Trikona reductions, the lesser number be reduced from the greater number and the lesser number is kept unaltered. On the contrary, if the sign occupied by the planet is left with greater number after the Trikona reduction than the sign without a planet, the number in the unoccupied sign be totally eleminated while the number of the occupied sign be kept intact. If both the signs of a planet are unoccupied and are having an identental number after the Trikona reduction, eliminate the number from both the signs. If one of the two signs owned by the same planet is occupied and the other is unoccupied and both these signs are left with equal number after the Trikona Shodhana, eliminate the number from the unoccupied sign. The signs Cancer and Leo are not subjected to any kind of reduction and the number so obtained after the Trikona Shodhana is kept unchanged. (This is possibily so because their lords own only one sign).

only place where the position of Mars causes obstacles in the happiness and-comforts of the husband. Placement of Mars in the 8th house denotes that the native is Manglika (मांगली). The 8th place from the 7th house is the 2nd house. This 2nd house is considered as the house of longevity or death of the husband. If the 8th house of a female holds two or more than two malefic planets, the 2nd house of such nativity will have the aspect of these malefic planets and that will indicate an adverse situation for the longevity of the husband of the native. In the 28th and 47th Shlokas of this very Chapter have stated that the position of Mars in the 8th house makes the native responsible for the husband's death. Here are two illustrations to affirm this contention. The husband of this native died due to throat disease after one and half years of the marriage. In the birth chart, Rahu, Saturn and Mars are posited in the 8th house forming a direct aspect over the 2nd house. This 2nd house is owned by Mercury. The signs belonging to Mercury always react swiftly. Therefore, in a short time after the marriage, this tragedy took place. The placement of malefic planets in the 8th house are therefore, not welcomed especially in context with the happenings of the life. In the instant horoscope, the 8th house is harbouring Saturn, Mars and Venus of which first two are first rated malefic planets. In the 2nd house, Jupiter is posited in its own sign. The lord of the house of longevity of the house, Karaka of the husband and the Bhava Karaka (2nd house) all the three factors related to the husband, are being represented by Jupiter. The 2nd house is also badly afflicted. Therefore, the husband died after 7 years of the marriage. Besides, this woman never experienced the lascivious comforts of the marriage. The reason being that firstly, the Karaka for such traits of life is Venus which is in the sign of debilitation and is also badly afflicted through the conjunction of two malefic planets and secondly, the lord of the spouse house (7th) Sun is receiving a malefic aspect of Saturn. Therefore, her husband, most of the time in this space of 7 years, remained sick and the obvious reason was the aspect of the Saturn over the Sun. This maleficence became prominent due to the fact that Saturn is the lord of the 12th house which is 6th (house of disease) from the 7th (house of husband) and when ever any connection between the Ascendant (body) and the 6th house is formed, the body contracts some disease. Both these horoscopes demonstrate the ill effects of the positioning of the malefic planets in the 8th house which resulted in the shortening the life of the husbands.

translation:
The version of Phaldeepika is all together different which states such woman will be an important woman. As a matter of fact, the results depicted by Phaldeepika and Jataka Parijata appear to be more relevant in this context. The basis of this statement, in addition to the experience, are some technical reasons which are as follows:
(i) Mercury signifies handicraft especially work of minute nature such as making ornaments etc.
(ii) Venus, on the other hand, is fond of ornaments and finances are also controlled by it
(iii) Mercury is considered as hermaphrodite planet
(iv) In a natural horoscope, Venus owns the 2nd house which denotes apart from other things, mouth and due to this fact, the eatables like food, milk products etc., also being signified by it
(v) Here, Mercury being a hermaphrodite planet and Venus being a planet of passion and lust, it will not give less indulgence in sex because this combination carries conflict within itself. It is here, Maharishi has stated, that if there be Trimsamsa of Saturn, the native will be hermaphrodite which is quite true because both the planets involved in creating this situation in the Vargas are hermaphrodite planets. In the Mercury's Ascendant and also in the Trimsamsa of Mercury in the birth chart of a female, she will possess many qualities. Infact, these qualities are related to the sculptural trait. Such woman is also good in house holds. She would be expert in all kinds of works and carries out her duties most diligently. In the event of Ascendant or Moon, whatever is the case, is in the sign of Venus and in the Trimsamsa of Mars, she will be an unchaste woman. This expression is in line with the Shloka-9 ibid. Should it be in the Trimsamsa of Venus, she will possess great qualities. Infact, such a woman will be highly civilised, having a sweet voice and loves music. Her work will have an artistic touch. She organises herself well and keeps a perfect equilibrium in every sphere of her work. According to Phaldeepika, such female is a reputed woman. translation:
9-16: If Rahu is posited in the 5th house and aspected by Mars or similar combination is formed in Aries or Scorpio sign, it will cause childlessness due to the curse of the 'Snake' (नाग).

When lord of the 5th house conjoins with Rahu and Saturn forms conjunction with or aspects the Moon in the 5th house, it will cause loss of children attributed to the curse of the 'Snake'.

Should Jupiter conjoin Rahu, lord of the 5th house is weak, lord of the Ascendant is conjunct with Mars, there will be loss of children owing to the curse of the 'Snake'.

Conjunction of Jupiter and Mars, Rahu's position in the Ascendant, the 5th lord being in a Trik house (6th, 8th, 12th) will also give effect to the childlessness.

If 5th lord Mercury is in the Navamsa of Mars and conjoined with Mars, the ascendant contains Rahu and Mandi, the curse of 'Snake' will destroy the children (progeny).
If the 5th house is of the sign of Mars and the 5th lord is in conjunction with Rahu and is also under the aspect or conjunction of Mercury, it will denote loss of children as a result of the curse of the 'Snake'.
When the 5th house contains the Sun, Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Mercury, Jupiter and the 5th and the Ascendant lords are weak, the childlessness will be ascribed to the curse of the 'Snake'.
Conjunction of the lord of the Ascendant with Rahu and the lord of the 5th house with Mars or Jupiter with Rahu, will also effect the destruction of children attributed to the curse of the 'Snake'.

translation:
71-78: The one getting proud and overbearing of ones power, if insults the Brahmins, this affliction (दोष) or the curse of the Brahmins destorys the children (The kind of pride could be due to excessive property, physical strength, status, wealth etc.)
If Rahu is posited in the sign of Jupiter, the 5th house contains Jupiter, Mars and Saturn and the lord of the 9th house is posited in the 8th house, the children get destroyed due to the curse of the Brahmins.
When the 9th lord is in the 5th house, the lord of the 5th house be in the 8th house and gets conjunct with or aspected by Jupiter, Mars, Rahu, it will attribute childlessness due the curse of the Brahmins.
Should the lord of the 9th house get debilitated, the lord of the 12th house is posited in the 5th house and either gets conjunct or aspected by Rahu, it will cause loss of children as a result of the curse of the Brahmins.
If Jupiter being debilitated, Rahu is situated in the Ascendant or in the 5th house and the lord of the 5th house is in a Trik house (6th, 8th, 12th), it will also denote destruction of children following the curse from the Brahmins.
If Jupiter being the lord of the 5th house and posited in the 8th house duly conjunct with the malefic planet or the lord of the 5th house alongwith the Sun and the Moon is in the 8th house, there will be loss of children due to the curse of the Brahmins.
When Jupiter being in the Navaṁsa of Saturn and Saturn conjoins Mars and the lord of the 5th house is posited in the 12th house, the Brahmins' curse destroys the children.
Should the Ascendant contain's Jupiter and Saturn and Rahu being in the 9th house or Rahu joins Jupiter in the 12th house, even then it will cause deprivation of children.

translation: 106-108: To alleviate the affliction (दोष) and get released from the curse, the native should perform Shradha (श्राद्ध) at Gaya, Rudra Abhisheka (रुद्र अभिषेक) and charity of idol of Lord Bramha etc., should be done. Besides, cow, silver vessel and Neelamani (नीलमणि) be also given in a charity to the Brahmins. After feeding the Brahmins, they should be paid Dakshna (दक्षिण). By performing these rituals, the native will get released from the curse and birth of a child (son) will take place bestowing prolongation to the family.

translation: 1-4: Maharishi Parasara said - O Vipra ! Now I will narrate the causes of the inauspicious births despite the fact when Ascendant (लग्न) and other planets being auspicious and well disposed. If a birth takes place during the Amavasya (अमावास्या), or Chaturdasi of the darker half of the lunar month. (14th tithi of Krishna Paksha), in the prevalance of Vishti Karna (विष्टि करण), having the birth Nakshatra that of brother, in the birth Nakshatra of mother and father, during the solar ingress, during the Pata (क्रन्ति साम्य), at the time of Solar or Lunar eclipses, during in the prevalance of inauspicious Yogas like Vyatipata (व्यतीपात) etc. in all the three types of Gandants, during Yamaghant (यमघण्ट), Tithikshaya (तिथिक्षय), in the Yogas of Dagdha (दग्ध) etc., Tritara (त्रीतर) birth (son's birth after the birth of three daughters and vice-versa), a freak birth (some degree of disability) are considered inauspicious births. Performing of propitiatory measures will be beneficial and therefore, I now explain these measures (rituals) in the succeedingly narrations.

rule.out_of_scope_reason: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, and muhurta-based birth circumstances (Amavasya, Chaturdasi, Vishti Karna, solar ingress, eclipses, Gandanta, Yamaghanta, Dagdha yoga, etc.) are outside the scope of planetary and house fact tokens.

translation:
transactions be caused.
In the last Shloka, the Sage has emphasised the transit positions of the planets. Although the Dasa may be unfavourable, if the said planet is having a favourable transit in the signs of auspicious houses, it will not produce unfavourable results as long as it remains in that transit. Conversely, if the planet is having a favourable Dasa but the transit is not good, in that case, the favourable results gets forestalled till the time the planet is passing through such a phase of the transit.

rule.out_of_scope_reason: Transit and Dasa interaction principle described generically without specific planetary placements or outcomes

effects.statement: Transit positions of planets can modify or forestall Dasas depending on whether the transit is favorable or unfavorable

translation: 9-13: The results of the Dasa of the 10th lord will be auspicious if conjunct with the 5th or the 9th lord. The Dasa of the other planets will also be favourable if posited with the 5th lord. Conjunction of the 9th lord with the other planets will cause exceedingly good results during the Dasa of such planets. The Dasa of the 9th lord if conjoined with the 4th lord and the Dasa of the 10th lord if posited in the 5th house are also the benefic Dasas. The Dasas of the Trine lords occupying Angles (kendras) position or the Angle lords located in the Trine houses, also render good results and these Dasas according to the Astrological Savants are said to be extremely auspicious.
